skill.desc_ko: 평소엔 생존자(학생 NPC)처럼 보이며 공격 대상에서 제외. 플레이어가 가까이 오면 정체를 드러내며 기습, 이후 보라색 그림자가 따라붙음.

lore_ko: 서울시립대 새내기 새로배움터에 섞여 든 감염자. 화장으로 피부를 가리고 새터 티셔츠·이름표까지 챙겼지만, 목과 볼의 갈라진 틈과 등 뒤 손은 숨기지 못했다.

art.style: flat color vector, bold dark outline (3.5px at 400px width), no gradients, not pixel art
art.view: front, standing friendly with closed smile, orientation guidebook in left hand, right hand hidden behind back with claws peeking out by the hip

pivot.note: normalized, origin top-left; at the feet

art.vfx_note: the purple shadow silhouette is baked in; for disguise state, remove the first <g fill=#4B3A6E> group and the claw glow to get a 'human' sprite

identifying_features: peach makeup skin with cracked cheek revealing green; neck left green
claws peeking from behind right hip with purple glow
large purple zombie shadow (arms raised) behind the body

gameplay.hitbox_note: suggested body hitbox x 0.30-0.70, y 0.12-0.92 of sprite
